verses.author: human
verses.text:
Steam curls from warm rice bowls
evening gathers quietly
the first autumn breeze

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a moth taps the window
looking for the light it lost
the lamp hums back to sleep

verses.author: human
verses.text:
the kettle begins
to whisper before sunrise

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a single cup waits
warmth I haven't asked for yet
morning finds its way

verses.author: human
verses.text:
a spoon circles
golden honey into oats

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the last spoonful sticks
some sweetness always lingers
past the point of taste

verses.author: human
verses.text:
apple peels curl
beside the cutting board

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
soft-brown at the edge
where the knife forgot to slice
someone will eat this too

verses.author: human
verses.text:
stale bread becomes
golden crumbs in warm butter

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
nothing thrown away
just given one more shape to hold
before the last bite

verses.author: human
verses.text:
plum blossoms fall
into the waiting tea

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
still warm from the kettle
one petal steeping slow
color no one asked for
